method: Five deterministic candidate universes, 1200-day history, top 3 funds, 20-trading-day periods. Product-level pairs only count funds that remained in the top 3 after the observation period, matching the real trial-entry rule.
reason: 10% retained 48 product-level qualifying pairs and produced the strongest next-period average return and win rate. High-gain funds are intentionally allowed by user preference.
limitations: Historical purchase limits are not reconstructed.
This diagnostic supports threshold selection but cannot guarantee future profit.
